WITH groups AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') as status, COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally) as total, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM groups
)
SELECT 
  g.status,
  g.tally,
  CAST(g.tally AS REAL) / t.total as share,
  CAST(g.tally AS REAL) / t.total - (1.0 / t.num_groups) as above_average
FROM groups g, totals t
WHERE CAST(g.tally AS REAL) / t.total > (1.0 / t.num_groups)
